hazards.description: The wide median is not designed as a pedestrian refuge, leaving people exposed in the middle of a high-speed roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the intersection where the grassy median ends

hazards.name: Absence of sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk in the roadway or through unpaved/parking areas due to the lack of dedicated walkways.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground and midground along the road edges.

hazards.name: Poor pavement quality
hazards.description: The road surface is cracked and uneven, creating potential tripping hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway surface.

hazards.name: Excessive curb cut width
hazards.description: The gas station entrance is extremely wide and lacks definition, creating a large conflict zone where vehicles can cross the pedestrian path at various angles and speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and midground where the sidewalk meets the gas station lot

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at intersections or mid-block to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to designate safe crossing points and alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this wide, unmarked residential street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the nearest intersections to improve visibility and shorten the crossing distance for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to physically enforce a low-speed environment appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Improved Street Lighting
interventions.description: Ensure adequate pedestrian-scale lighting is present to improve safety and security during evening hours.

interventions.title: Vertical Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Add speed humps or speed cushions to physically slow down traffic to residential speeds.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near intersections and potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Expand the sidewalk width and relocate utility poles to a dedicated furniture zone to ensure an ADA-compliant, unobstructed clear path.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to create a physical and psychological buffer from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve safety and security at night.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strips
interventions.description: Introduce a planting buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to improve pedestrian comfort and provide a physical barrier from traffic.

interventions.title: Lane markings and narrowing
interventions.description: Paint clear lane lines and consider narrowing travel lanes to naturally reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide a vertical buffer, improve the aesthetic of the pedestrian realm, and naturally encourage slower driving speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lamps to ensure the walkway and roadway are well-lit, improving safety and security for residents.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to physically slow traffic on this long, straight residential stretch.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Re-stripe the road to include narrower travel lanes and a buffered bike lane or wider sidewalk area.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the road to improve pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Intersection Improvements
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and curb extensions at the signalized intersection ahead.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage near the commercial deli to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Road Diet
interventions.description: Paint center lines and parking lane markings to narrow the perceived travel lanes and slow traffic.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Limit vehicle access to defined entry and exit points with standard-width driveways to reduce the area of conflict between pedestrians and cars.

interventions.title: Utility Relocation
interventions.description: Move the utility pole to the edge of the sidewalk or into a new furniture zone to ensure a continuous, unobstructed clear path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised refuge island within the median to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Intersection Tightening and Crosswalks
interventions.description: Use curb extensions and high-visibility crosswalks to reduce crossing distances and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Markings
interventions.description: Implement lane markings to organize traffic flow and reduce the effective width of the roadway, which helps lower vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Paint lane lines and parking stalls to narrow the travel way and slow traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks at intersections or mid-block to provide safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the gas station access points to the minimum necessary for safe vehicle entry and exit, restoring the curb and sidewalk to provide a continuous, protected path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: If an intersection is nearby, install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian signage to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.
